text_blocks.snippet: Ventricular fibrillation (V-fib) is a life-threatening heart rhythm disturbance requiring immediate treatment. The primary treatment involves defibrillation, which is the delivery of an electrical shock to the heart to restore a normal rhythm. Other crucial interventions include CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) and medications like epinephrine. Long-term management may involve implantable devices like ICDs.
